additional_info.subject: RE: 0430286-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / R8 170002515] Error on display CRM:02888000066
additional_info.body:
Hi Florent,
I hope you're doing well.
The VendorErrorCode “secc is offline” refers to a brief internal communication loss with the SECC, typically caused by a CoAP polling error. This disconnection is momentary—usually resolved within 5 seconds as the Controller automatically re-establishes the connection. Importantly, this event has no impact on the charger’s operation, including during active charging sessions.
To clarify, everything is functioning as intended. With the latest Sicharge D firmware version v6.1.3, new OCPP VendorErrorCodes have been introduced. These codes are meant to give the backend more visibility into the charger's internal behavior. They do not indicate the presence of new issues—such communication drops have occurred previously, but were simply not reported before.
Additionally, the R&D team is already planning improvements for a future firmware release. These will reduce the frequency of such notifications when they are inconsequential and do not affect charger availability.
To summarize, these messages are not new errors, but rather newly reported behaviors introduced in FW v6.1.3.
If you have any further questions, Do let us know.
Looking forward to your feedback.
Thank and Best Regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Giridhar "Gary"
